items.question: What goods does HARUTO accept?
items.answer: The goods we can carry depend on each country's regulations. Our staff check the goods and documents before confirming acceptance.

items.question: How are shipping rates calculated?
items.answer: It depends on the direction. Vietnam → Japan is priced by weight band, with separate tables for clean and mixed goods (tax and Japan domestic delivery included); weight is rounded up to the next 0.5 kg and parcels over the size standard add a bulky-goods surcharge. Japan → Vietnam is 155,000 VND/kg for any weight; bulky goods use the greater of actual and volumetric weight (Length × Width × Height ÷ 6,000). See each direction's rate policy for details and surcharges.

items.question: Can I track my shipment online?
items.answer: Online tracking is being planned. For now, please contact our support staff to ask about your parcel's status.

items.question: Do I need a Visa or MasterCard to buy from Japan?
items.answer: No. Just send the product link: HARUTO quotes at the VCB + 5 rate (no surcharge) and pays the Japanese shop for you. For buying orders you pay 100% of the item price.

items.question: How much deposit does auction bidding need?
items.answer: A 50% deposit before bidding. If you win, you pay the rest and HARUTO settles the purchase; if you don't, HARUTO refunds 100% of the deposit.

items.question: Which websites can HARUTO buy from?
items.answer: Yahoo! Auction, Mercari, Rakuten, Amazon Japan and other Japanese online stores. Send the product link and HARUTO will check it and quote.

items.question: Can I buy myself and send the goods to HARUTO's Japan warehouse?
items.answer: Yes. With our shipping-only service you buy the goods yourself and send them to HARUTO's Japan warehouse address; HARUTO consolidates them free of charge and ships them to Vietnam.

items.question: What does HARUTO's fulfillment service include?
items.answer: Receiving and storage in Japan, inventory management, picking and packing to your requirements, delivery across Japan and regular order reports. HARUTO also handles Japan ⇄ Vietnam shipping.

items.question: Which businesses is fulfillment in Japan for?
items.answer: Vietnamese exporters to Japan, retailers selling on Japanese marketplaces, cross-border e-commerce businesses needing a transit warehouse, and Vietnamese brands growing in Japan.

items.question: How are bulky parcels to Japan surcharged?
items.answer: From Vietnam to Japan, the maximum length + width + height is 120 cm under 10 kg, 140–150 cm for 10–20 kg and 160–180 cm for 20–30 kg. Parcels over the standard, or with any side of 100 cm or more, may be charged a bulky-goods surcharge of 220,000–800,000 VND depending on size and parcel. Parcels over 260 cm or over 50 kg must be checked with us before sending.

items.question: Who pays for delivery within Vietnam?
items.answer: The customer pays for domestic delivery in Vietnam and can choose any delivery company. Book it yourself or ask HARUTO's warehouse staff to book it; the cost follows the chosen company's rate card.

items.question: How is the buy-for-you exchange rate calculated?
items.answer: Purchase price = order value × exchange rate. HARUTO applies VCB + 5 to every order value, with no surcharge.

guide.intro: HARUTO EXPRESS takes enquiries on Zalo, the Facebook page, hotlines in Vietnam and Japan, or the request form on this page. Pick whichever suits you and the HARUTO team will help with the route, the type of goods and the cost of your parcel.

items.zalo: Chat directly with a consultant. Send photos, product links or item details for quick advice on the route, goods type and cost.
items.facebook: Message HARUTO on the Facebook page and follow updates on the two-way Vietnam – Japan shipping service.
items.hotline: Call the Vietnam hotline when you are in Vietnam, or the Japan hotline when you are in Japan, to talk to the HARUTO team directly.
items.form: Leave your name, phone number, route and a description of the goods. The HARUTO team will call you back on the number you left.

guide.prepareTitle: What to have ready before you get in touch
prepare: The route: Vietnam → Japan or Japan → Vietnam.
The type of goods and a description, with photos or product links if you have them.
The expected weight and the parcel size (length × width × height).
Whether you are sending as a person or a business.

locations.japanWarehouse: Our Tokyo warehouse, where parcels for the Japan → Vietnam route are received.
locations.vietnamOffice: HARUTO's office in Ho Chi Minh City.

guide.hours: Open to visitors 9:00 – 17:00, Monday – Saturday (closed Sunday)
